cells.albedo: 10% | The albedo is the measure of reflectance, representing 10% for most typical scenarios.
cells.cable: 12 AWG | DC/AC combiner boxes are connected to the main panel via a 12-AWG (1.6 mm2) copper cable with an overall length less than 30 m, and all AC components are also placed nearby.
cells.capacity: 5000W | The maximum capacity is set at 5000 W based upon typical grid interconnection requirements and system load size.
cells.coatings: silver-coated reflective film | Solar cells were mounted on a glass substrate with a thin layer of a silver-coated reflective film below the SiO2 coating to avoid overheating during illumination tests.
cells.connection: series | For all the considered cases, DC cables connection between panels has been considered parallel while series configuration between cells and sub-modules respectively.
cells.efficiency: 15.6% | The highest peak power obtained for a module with an efficiency of about 15.6% was measured in 1 min with the mentioned above conditions, which is lower than the one reported by (Dey et al., [30]).
cells.energy: 2 MWh/yr | Based on energy production cost that is considered about $0.017 per kWh. Therefore annual life-cycle savings can be calculated by multiplying the mentioned factors with one-year expected operating hours of 10,000 h. Consequently, it can be shown that the total annual energy production from this array can reach to 2 MWh/yr.
cells.fill_factor: 78.57% | For comparison, this system used about half of modules with a fill-factor as low as 78.57%.
